messages.subject: East Water | Water security, data-center growth and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear East Water Leadership Team,

East Water's role in supplying critical water infrastructure to the Eastern Economic Corridor, including emerging data-center demand, creates a strong fit with my experience in resource governance and industrial stakeholder strategy.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy across a large resource operation.

I manage environmental and public-sector interfaces, community priorities and cross-functional action where resource security and operating continuity are tightly linked. I also bring energy-transition and carbon-governance experience, which strengthens my perspective on resilient industrial infrastructure.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or infrastructure stakeholder leadership. I have attached an East Water-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
